subject: Renewal + Expansion playbook: legal handoff & ops checklist
body:
From: Sarah Jin <sarah.jin@avalonhealth.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: 
Date: Thu, 07 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal + expansion: proposed numbers and procurement timeline

Hi Evelyn,

Thanks again for a great review yesterday. Avalon is excited to move forward with the renewal and the mid-contract capacity top-up we discussed. I attached our internal MA proposal (short version) so you can see the timing constraints from procurement. Two items we need clarity on before we give the green light:

- Final uplift pricing if we add an additional 250k tokens/month of reserved capacity (we care about both steady-state unit price and an early-bird discount if we commit for 12 months).
- How co-term would work if we add capacity now but keep our existing annual renewal date (Nov 1). Do we prorate, or do you propose an amendment that annualizes the new commit?

Procurement asked that any commercial changes be accompanied by a short legal summary and a SOW draft to speed signature. Can Redwood provide a one-page commercial summary + SOW stub for our legal team?

Appreciate it — Sarah

[Attachment: Avalon_MA-Plan_v1.pdf (pdf) — 120KB]

---
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Jin <sarah.jin@avalonhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 07 Jul 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal + expansion: proposed numbers and procurement timeline

Thanks Sarah — we can get this moving. Quick summary of what Redwood can do and next steps:

1) Pricing options (high-level):
   - Option A (12-month committed uplift): add 250k tokens/month, 10% uplift discount on unit price for the uplift portion if signed for 12 months.
   - Option B (6-month bridge + co-term): add capacity now on a 6-month term at a slightly higher unit price, then annualize on Nov 1 with a true-up invoice and prorated credit.
   - Option C (pay-as-you-go burst with reserved buffer): reserved bucket of 100k tokens + burst to hosted rates, with lower operational overhead but higher unit cost.

2) Co-term mechanics: We typically support co-term via an amendment that either annualizes the new commit (preferred) or invoices a prorated uplift for the remainder of the year and rolls into the next renewal. I flagged this for legal.

3) Deliverables for procurement/legal: Ben will send a commercial one-pager and the uplift calculator; Laura will prepare a short SOW + amendment template for review.

Can you confirm Avalon’s preference between Option A vs Option B so we can produce the right SOW language? If procurement prefers documents routed to procurement@avalonhealth.com, copy that address and we’ll send the package there.

Best,
Evelyn

--
Evelyn Hart
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

---
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Jin <sarah.jin@avalonhealth.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 07 Jul 2027 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal + expansion: proposed numbers and procurement timeline

Sarah — attaching the uplift calculator and a commercial one-pager. I ran the numbers for Option A vs Option B below (net of standard renewal discounts).

- Option A (12-month uplift): incremental 250k tokens/month, unit price $0.0024/token, blended expected monthly cost ~ $600. Early-commit 10% off uplift portion for 12 months (effective unit $0.00216).
- Option B (6-month bridge): incremental 250k tokens/month, unit price $0.0027/token, true-up/annualize on Nov 1 with prorate credit on the remainder. Short-term cost higher but gives flexibility.

If Avalon wants to annualize immediately and keep November 1 renewal date, we can draft the amendment that sets the annualized committed units and issues a pro-rata invoice for the remainder of the current year. See calculator attached for invoice illustrations.

[Attachment: Redwood-Uplift-Calculator.xlsx (xlsx) — contains monthly breakdowns, prorate examples, and blended unit calculations]

Next ops asks: who from Avalon will own the PO/PO number and expected signature timeline? Helps us prepare billing and provisioning.

Cheers,
Ben

---
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sarah Jin <sarah.jin@avalonhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 08 Jul 2027 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal + expansion: proposed numbers and procurement timeline

Sarah / Avalon team —

I reviewed the proposed approaches and sketched the legal mechanics. Two quick notes for procurement:

1) Amendment vs. SOW:
   - Amendment route (preferred): simple commercial amendment that increases the committed units, adjusts unit pricing for the uplift portion, and keeps the existing master terms intact. This preserves the Nov 1 renewal cadence if you elect to annualize.
   - SOW route: if you need service-level specifics for the new capacity (onboarding runbooks, priority provisioning windows), we can attach a short SOW. That’s useful if you want defined provisioning SLAs for the uplift.

2) Invoice and taxes: Reductions for early-commit discounts will be reflected on the first uplift invoice. If Avalon prefers credits instead of invoice reductions, we can provide credit notes.

I’ll produce a redline-ready amendment and minimal SOW template and route to procurement@avalonhealth.com. Evelyn / Ben — please confirm the exact uplift units and which pricing option they prefer so I can incorporate the numbers.

Thanks,
Laura
General Counsel (Commercial)
Redwood Inference

---
From: Avalon Procurement <procurement@avalonhealth.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 10 Jul 2027 13:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal + expansion: proposed numbers and procurement timeline

Hi Evelyn / Ben / Laura —

Procurement here. We ran internal approvals; Avalon will proceed with Option A (12-month committed uplift) conditional on:

- Inclusion of the early-commit 10% uplift discount in the contract language.
- SOW to include a 5-business-day provisioning SLA after fully executed amendment + proof of billing change.
- PO will be issued within 7 business days after we receive the final amendment + SOW and a DocuSign link. PO number: AH-PO-9883.

Please send the amendment + SOW to procurement@avalonhealth.com and cc sarah.jin@avalonhealth.com. We expect countersigned docs by Jul 21 so we can meet our internal budget cutover.

Thanks,
Avalon Procurement

[Attachment: Avalon_SOW_Draft.docx (docx) — SOW scaffold provided by Avalon for reference]

---
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwoodinference.com>
To: Avalon Procurement <procurement@avalonhealth.com>, Sarah Jin <sarah.jin@avalonhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 10 Jul 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal + expansion: proposed numbers and procurement timeline

Great — thanks for the confirmation and the PO number. Laura and I will send a redline-ready amendment and an attached SOW that includes the 5-business-day provisioning SLA and explicit language for the 10% early-commit discount. Ben will include the uplift calculator and the commercial one-pager in the same envelope.

DocuSign link will be included; expecting you to return countersigned by Jul 21 per your timeline. We’ll plan provisioning for a target activation window of Jul 26–30 pending final signature.

Action items (Redwood):
- Laura: draft amendment + SOW (today).
- Ben: attach uplift calculator + one-pager (today).
- Evelyn: send DocuSign and routing instructions to procurement@avalonhealth.com; monitor for PO and signature.

If there are any governance requirements we missed (SOC, encryption KMS notes), flag now and we’ll include the short exhibit.

Best,
Evelyn

[Attachments: Redwood-Uplift-Calculator.xlsx, Avalon_SOW_Draft.docx, Avalon_MA-Plan_v1.pdf]
